description: The Daily Digest: one synthesis per day per category (e.g. gold, oil, us_bonds, top macro themes, policy_makers), written from all providers' views that day — the read, why, sub-splits, individual names, where providers appear to disagree — with the day's code-computed tallies, structured highlights (consensus by asset, apparent disagreements with each side's horizon and condition, notable names) and, where it exists, a short note on how the read evolved over the previous two weeks. Best for the picture on a market and how it moved day by day. Category keys (has_daily_digest) come from list_categories.

categories.description: Category keys, e.g. ["gold"] or ["top", "policy_makers"]. "__overall__" is the cross-asset summary.

limit.description: Digests per page, at most 100. Default 30.

offset.description: Skip this many items; pass the previous response's next_offset to read the next page.

since.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 14 days ago. The free plan reaches back 7 days.

until.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: today.

name: get_daily_digests
title: Get daily digest summaries
